name: Musique (ACE-Step 1.5 XL)
description: Composer une musique avec ACE-Step 1.5 XL : chanson aux paroles chantées ou morceau instrumental, de 10 secondes à 10 minutes, en stéréo 48 kHz.

lyrics.description: The words to sing, in the language set in language, one line per sung line, with section tags on their own line: [Intro], [Verse], [Pre-Chorus], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]. Write them in full when the user wants a song (their own words if they gave any). Empty for an instrumental piece. Never put the style here.

seconds.description: Length in seconds: the length the user asked for. About 60 to 90 for a short song with a verse and a chorus, 150 to 240 for a full song; 30 when the user wants a short loop or jingle.

language.description: Language the lyrics are sung in (fr for French). Ignored for an instrumental piece.
